# @devdogsuga/env

> 标签: JavaScript

## 简介

Env-registry machinery: declare()/define() manifests, target/tier resolution, with-env session loading, and a @t3-oss/env-nextjs re-export. Ships no variables — the registry of actual names and schemas is repo data that stays in the consuming app.
